card.statement:
Let $G$ be an affine smooth algebraic group over $k$. We define the following presheaves of sets on $\mathsf{Aff}_{k}={\mathsf{CAlg}}_{k}^{\mathrm{op}}$.

•

The affine Grassmannian of the loop group is the presheaf quotient $LLG/JLG$. In this case we are considering $H=JLG$, so that $H(R)=JLG(R)=G\big(R[\![t]\!](\!(s)\!)\big)$. We denote it as

$\mathcal{G}r^{L}_{G}:R\longmapsto\frac{LLG(R)}{JLG(R)}=\frac{G\big(R(\!(t)\!)(\!(s)\!)\big)}{G\big(R[\![t]\!](\!(s)\!)\big)}=\mathcal{G}r_{LG}(R)$

hence we are studying the analog of the affine Grassmannian for the loop group $LG$.

•

The loop space of the affine Grassmannian is the presheaf quotient $LLG/LJG$. In this case we are considering $H=LJG$, so that $H(R)=LJG(R)=G\big(R(\!(t)\!)[\![s]\!]\big)$. We denote it as

${}^{L}\mathcal{G}r_{G}:R\longmapsto\frac{LLG(R)}{LJG(R)}=\frac{G\big(R(\!(t)\!)(\!(s)\!)\big)}{G\big(R(\!(t)\!)[\![s]\!]\big)}=L(\mathcal{G}r_{G})(R)$

hence we are studying the loop presheaf of the usual affine Grassmannian of $G$.

•

The Big Grassmannian is the presheaf quotient $LLG/JJG$. In this case we are considering $H=JJG$, so that $H(R)=JJG(R)=G\big(R[\![t]\!][\![s]\!]\big)$. We denote it as follows:

$\mathcal{G}r^{big}_{G}:R\longmapsto\frac{LLG(R)}{JJG(R)}=\frac{G\big(R(\!(t)\!)(\!(s)\!)\big)}{G\big(R[\![t]\!][\![s]\!]\big)}.$

•

The 2-dimensional local field affine Grassmannian is the presheaf quotient $LLG/G^{(2)}$, where for a given a $k$ -algebra $R$ we put $\mathcal{O}^{\prime\prime}(R)=R[\![t]\!]+\sum_{i>0}R(\!(t)\!)s^{i}\subset R(\!(t)\!)[\![s]\!]$, and consider the subgroup of $LLG(R)$ given by $G^{(2)}(R)=G(\mathcal{O}^{\prime\prime}(R))$. The 2-dimensional local field affine Grassmannian is denoted as

$\mathcal{G}r^{(2)}_{G}:R\longmapsto\frac{LLG}{G^{(2)}}(R)=\frac{LLG(R)}{G(\mathcal{O}^{\prime\prime}(R))}=\frac{G\big(R(\!(t)\!)(\!(s)\!)\big)}{G\big(R[\![t]\!]+\sum_{i>0}R(\!(t)\!)s^{i}\subset R(\!(t)\!)[\![s]\!]\big)}$

•

The affine Grassmannian of the jet group is the presheaf quotient $LJG/JJG$ and is denoted as

$\mathcal{G}r^{J}_{G}:R\longmapsto\frac{LJG(R)}{JJG(R)}=\frac{G\big(R(\!(t)\!)[\![s]\!]\big)}{G\big(R[\![t]\!][\![s]\!]\big)}=\mathcal{G}r_{JG}(R)$

which is indeed the analog of the affine Grassmannian for the jet group $JG$.
card.label: Definition 1.5

paper.title: Two dimensional versions of the affine Grassmannian and their geometric description
paper.abstract: For a smooth affine algebraic group $G$ over an algebraically closed field, we consider several two-variables generalizations of the affine Grassmannian $G(\!(t)\!)/G[\![t]\!]$, given by quotients of the double loop group $G(\!(x)\!)(\!(y)\!)$. We prove that they are representable by ind-schemes if $G$ is solvable. Given a smooth surface $X$ and a flag of subschemes of $X$, we provide a geometric interpretation of the two-variables Grassmannians, in terms of bundles and trivialisation data defined on appropriate loci in $X$, which depend on the flag.
